$comment: Maintainers' picks for the gallery's front page. Ids must exist in scripts/. The first hero is the banner; the rest and editorsChoice fill the Editors' Choice shelf. Blurbs are one line.

blurbs.cowsay-news: A cow takes the temperature of today's headlines, or says whatever you tell it to.
blurbs.repo-stats: Stars, forks and open issues for any repository, right on your Home Screen.
blurbs.golden-hour: Know exactly when the light turns golden, with a countdown on your Lock Screen.
blurbs.minesweeper: The whole game inside a Home Screen widget, first tap always safe.
blurbs.day-plan: Calendar, reminders and free gaps on one timeline, with the commute weather.
blurbs.artwork-of-the-day: A public-domain masterpiece from the Art Institute of Chicago, new every morning.
blurbs.planes-overhead: See what is flying over you right now, and point your phone at it.
blurbs.portfolio-pulse: Stocks, ETFs and coins in one total, with allocation and a 30-day trend.
blurbs.recovery-score: HRV, resting heart rate, breathing and sleep against your own baseline.
blurbs.newsstand: Your feeds laid out like a front page, with read-later and unread tracking.
blurbs.shelf-scanner: Scan a barcode, track your pages, and see when you will finish the book.
blurbs.star-chart: Chores become stars in a widget your kids can tap themselves.
blurbs.parked-car: Finds where you parked by itself and walks you back, meter timer included.
blurbs.palette-lab: Harmonies, WCAG contrast grids and CSS export for your colour palettes.
